summary: Comprehensive testing of GST Statutory Module for Kairos AI ERP. All 26 backend tests passed (100%). All 4 frontend pages (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, E-Invoicing, TDS Returns) load correctly with proper data display. Sidebar shows separate GST and TDS sections as required.
test_credentials: No authentication required - all endpoints are public
seed_data_creation: None - used existing PolyMerx seed data
context_for_next_testing_agent: GST Statutory Module fully tested. GSTR-1 shows 8 B2C Small invoices (no B2B since seeded customers lack 15-char GSTINs). GSTR-3B shows net payable of ~11.58L. E-Invoicing shows 0 eligible invoices (expected). TDS Returns shows 0 deductees (expected). HSN suggest endpoint works with Claude via Emergent LLM key.

gstr1_api.details: GET /api/statutory/gstr1 returns B2B, B2C Large, B2C Small, HSN summary, document summary with IGST/CGST/SGST split

gstr3b_api.details: GET /api/statutory/gstr3b returns sections 3.1 (outward), 3.2 (inter-state), 4 (ITC), 6.1 (payment) with net payable ~11.58L

e_invoices_api.details: GET /api/statutory/e-invoices returns eligible B2B invoices with IRN hashes (0 eligible with current seed data)

e_invoice_json_api.details: GET /api/statutory/e-invoice/{invoice_number}/json returns NIC-format IRN JSON, 404 for invalid

tds_return_api.details: GET /api/statutory/tds-return returns deductee list and TDS summary (Form 26Q)

hsn_suggest_api.details: POST /api/gst/suggest-hsn with description returns HSN/SAC code via Claude LLM

gstr1_page.details: Frontend /gstr-1 loads with B2B/B2C sections, summary cards (8 invoices, CGST 9.12L, SGST 9.12L), export button

gstr3b_page.details: Frontend /gstr-3b loads with net tax liability card (11.58L), sections 3.1/3.2/4/6.1, export button

einvoicing_page.details: Frontend /e-invoicing loads with invoice list and IRN JSON viewer panel

tds_returns_page.details: Frontend /tds-returns loads with deductee table and summary cards

sidebar_gst_tds_sections.details: Sidebar shows separate GST section (Dashboard, GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, E-Invoicing) and TDS section (TDS Returns)
